steps.instruction: Add a new variant { kind: "clear" } to the Command union. Change nothing else. Todo stays the same; its existing `done` field is the 'completed' flag.
steps.interfaceChange: export type Command = { kind: "add"; title: string; due?: string; } | { kind: "complete"; id: number; } | { kind: "list"; } | { kind: "clear"; };

steps.instruction: Add a 'clear' command that removes every todo whose `done` field is true. (1) Export a pure function `clear(todos: Todo[]): Todo[]` that returns a new array containing only the todos with done === false, keeping their order and ids unchanged; it must not mutate the input. (2) parseArgs(["clear"]) returns { kind: "clear" } (types now adds this variant to Command: `| { kind: "clear" }`). (3) run(path, { kind: "clear" }) loads the todos from path, applies clear, saves the result back to path, and returns the text `Cleared N completed todos.` where N is the number removed. Keep all existing behaviour and tests unchanged.
steps.interfaceChange: export declare function clear(todos: Todo[]): Todo[];

input.reason: The Todo type has no field called `completed`. Its `done` flag is what the complete command sets, so I'm reading 'completed' as done === true. This plan adds a clear variant to Command in types, and a clear function plus parseArgs and run handling in commands.
